name: The Malibu Club
summary: The legendary Vice City nightlife institution featuring neon dance floors, VIP lounges, and high-profile criminal connections.
description: A celebrated icon of Vice City lore, The Malibu Club appears prominently renovated in Leonida's nightlife scene. Flashing vibrant magenta and cyan strobe lighting, the club hosts elite DJs, high-society socialites, and underworld brokers operating out of private mezzanine booths.
